about.title: About Us
about.intro: Learn more about who we are, what drives us, and the people behind Ahlin Myanmar Aotearoa.
about.whoWeAreBody: Ahlin Myanmar Aotearoa is a community-led organisation built to bring Myanmar people together in New Zealand through care, culture, and collaboration. We are not a political organisation. Our focus is on helping those who have left Myanmar — often due to hardship or difficult circumstances — settle well in Aotearoa New Zealand, and on building real, lasting support between members of our community. We welcome all Myanmar people, regardless of ethnicity, religion, or visa type, and encourage open, respectful discussion of ideas and experiences.
about.missionBody: Our mission is to build a strong, sustainable Myanmar community in New Zealand by working across six key areas: Settlement Support, helping newcomers find their footing in a new country; Health and Well-being, supporting physical and mental wellness; Employment, connecting people with work and career opportunities; Family Support, strengthening households and relationships; Immigration Support, helping navigate visa and residency processes; and Cultural Preservation, keeping Myanmar traditions and heritage alive for future generations. We invite professionals, skilled individuals, and anyone passionate about this work to contribute in whatever way they can.
about.teamBody: Our team is made up of dedicated volunteers from across the Myanmar community, each contributing their time and skills to support our programmes and events.

community.title: Community
community.intro: Explore the ways we support and connect our community members across Aotearoa New Zealand.
community.supportBody: We offer social gatherings, information sharing, and guidance to helpful services and providers — helping community members navigate life in New Zealand with confidence and support.
community.directoryBody: Our community directory connects you with trusted local services, providers, and fellow community members who can help with everything from settling in to everyday needs.

programmes.title: Programmes
programmes.intro: Discover our tailored programmes designed to support different groups within our community.
programmes.youthBody: Our Youth programme offers sports, cultural games, and swimming activities that help young people stay active, build friendships, and connect with their Myanmar heritage.
programmes.womenBody: Our Women's programme includes walking groups, swimming sessions, and mindfulness activities designed to support wellbeing and build a strong, connected network of women in our community.
programmes.professionalsBody: Our Professionals programme connects skilled and career-driven members of our community, offering networking opportunities and support for career growth in New Zealand.

events.title: Events
events.intro: Stay up to date with our regular gatherings, special celebrations, and annual meetings.
events.regularBody: We host regular community gatherings throughout the year, giving members a chance to connect, socialise, and stay engaged with what's happening in our community.
events.specialBody: From cultural festivals to milestone celebrations, our special events bring the community together to celebrate our heritage and shared achievements.
events.agmBody: Our Annual General Meeting and member gatherings are where we review the year's progress, share plans for the future, and hear directly from our members.

humanitarian.title: Humanitarian
humanitarian.body: We are committed to providing humanitarian aid to Myanmar refugees and war victims. Through fundraising efforts and community support, we help those affected by conflict access essential resources and stand in solidarity with those still facing hardship back home.

news.title: News & Stories
news.body: Follow our latest news, community stories, and updates from Ahlin Myanmar Aotearoa. Check back regularly for highlights from our events, member spotlights, and announcements.

getInvolved.title: Get Involved
getInvolved.intro: There are many ways to support Ahlin Myanmar Aotearoa and be part of our journey.
getInvolved.volunteerBody: Volunteers are the heart of everything we do. Whether it's helping at events, supporting our programmes, or lending your skills, there's a place for you to contribute.
getInvolved.membershipBody: Become a member of Ahlin Myanmar Aotearoa to stay connected with our community, access member events, and have a voice in shaping our future.
getInvolved.sponsorshipBody: Sponsorship from individuals and businesses helps fund our programmes and humanitarian efforts. Partner with us to make a lasting impact on our community.
